Hi, thanks so much for visiting my website!


Murray State University | Murray, KY | Bachelor’s in Mathematics



Carnegie Mellon University Undergraduate Research Experience in Sports Analytics. My research topic was Quantifying Faceoffs and Identifying High Leverage Performance in the NHL and was collaborated on with Chloe Guagliano and Jack Pallotta and sponsored by the Pittsburgh Penguins.



I am a current undergraduate Junior at Murray State University majoring in Mathematics and minoring in Statistics. Some of my favorite sports include Formula One, gymnastics, and pole vault.
